(TRIVALENT)"}],"comment":"Dimension D21 has a tolerance band of 0.04 mm on a part that receives zinc plating, but the drawing does not state whether the ±0.02 mm applies before or after plating. The designer should add a note clarifying if the dimension is pre-plate or post-plate so the machinist can compensate for coating buildup.","recommended_correction":"Add a note specifying whether D21 is a pre-plating or post-plating dimension, and adjust the machining target accordingly."},{"rule_id":"MF-005","evidence":[{"kind":"note","ref":"N1","page":1,"quote":"HEAT TREATMENT :-\n1) TO BE TEMPERED UPTO 24-32 HRC.\n2) RETAPPING TO BE DONE AFTER SURFACE TREATMENT AT SUPPLIER END.( IF APPLICABLE )"}],"comment":"Note N1 specifies tempering to 24-32 HRC but does not state at which manufacturing stage the heat treatment must be performed relative to machining and surface treatment. Without this sequence the shop cannot plan operations correctly, risking distortion of finished features or damage to the coating. The designer should specify the order, for example 'heat treat after rough machining, finish machine after heat treatment, then apply surface treatment.'","recommended_correction":"Update N1 to explicitly state when the heat treatment applies in the process sequence (e.g., before final machining and before plating)."}]}
